key: e:cost estimating and assessment guide gao-20-195g
synopsis: Chapter 12 identifies the Cost Estimating and Assessment Guide (GAO-20-195G, 2020) as the companion to GAO’s Schedule Assessment Guide [f9629]. The glossary restates that relationship and specifies the publication date as March 2020 [f16434]. The booklet recommends the guide as the natural template for estimating and presenting the capability’s costs, but the supplied facts provide no specific estimating procedures or cost figures [f16440].

relations.note: Both identify the cost guide as the Schedule Assessment Guide’s companion.
Its role as the cost companion supports using it as the cost-estimating template.
